g.text: M2: a reused slot should not be charged as a fresh allocation
Same token-VTC, pools, runtime cap and workload. State8 / separate 4K / short-first; no prefix caching.
Trajectory is a predeclared repetition, not an average; dots show all formal runs. No universal batching claim.
